newsitem.title: USA: Zycad sees return to profitability.
newsitem.headline: Zycad sees return to profitability.

text.p: Zycad Corp said it expects to report a fourth quarter nominal loss from operations, with revenues of about $11 million.

In addition, it said it expects to report non-operating expenses from its May 1996 financing. This non-cash interest charge relates to $10 million of Convertible Debentures the company issued in May 1996.
The company is currently completing its financial results for the fourth quarter and expects to release both final fourth quarter and total 1996 information in mid March.
Zycad said it expects to return to profitability in 1997.
